markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (82%)** · Confident · Read in turn

Single-class conformal set; second model and neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 82%, InSitu 16%, others 1% each | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.998 / 94th percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Normal | Mostly concordant |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 2) · ↓ invasive · Scored well below typical here (12/20 spot check) · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Slightly below typical; no push toward invasive · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Slightly above typical; negligible concept-model contribution · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (+0.002; −0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier; duct-confined is only Weak.

## Could be wrong if
- Image is a degraded resample (severity 3); InSitu still carries 16%.
- Reliability score only moderately ranks errors (AUROC 0.69, small test set).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 2:** check ducts for atypical cells; the duct-confined score is only weakly validated.
2. **Regions 9, 10:** look for stromal infiltration and nuclear pleomorphism; both concepts passed spot checks.
3. **Region 3:** highest per-region invasive probability (24%); confirm it is benign.
